item.title: Pacers’ Johnny Furphy leaves game with injury
item.description: Pacers guard Johnny Furphy left the game against the Raptors on Sunday with right leg soreness after a dunk, and will undergo testing in New York to determine the extent of the injury.

item.title: FBI concluded Jeffrey Epstein wasn’t running a sex trafficking ring for powerful men, files show

item.title: Hailey Buzbee’s family invites community to celebration of life
item.description: The family of Hailey Buzbee is inviting the public to join a celebration of life on Thursday to honor the Fishers teenager's memory.

item.title: Teen killed by police in Elkhart after suspicious vehicle stop
item.description: A 17-year-old male was shot and killed by police in Elkhart, Indiana after an officer noticed a suspicious vehicle in a closed lot, resulting in a confrontation and the firing of guns.

item.title: Clouds linger then early week thaw raises river concerns | Feb. 8, 2026
item.description: The week ahead will bring a mix of cloudy and sunny skies with temperatures ranging from the low 20s to mid 40s, and a chance of light snow and rain towards the weekend, potentially causing localized flooding.

item.title: Van driver transporting Amish during Jay County crash recovering in the hospital
item.description: Four Amish construction workers were killed and a survivor is recovering in the hospital after a crash involving an undocumented semi truck driver on State Road 67 in Jay County, Indiana.

item.title: Seahawks stifle Patriots, win Super Bowl LX
item.description: The Seahawks defeated the Patriots 29-13 in Super Bowl LX, with the defense forcing three turnovers and sacking Patriots quarterback Drake Maye six times.
